description: MCPAgent configuration (python mcp/agent.py): the agent, and the MCP server it starts for itself.
Validated against schemas/mcpagent.schema.json; paths are relative to the repository root.
log_level: the agent's MCP client log level.
instructions_file, models_file, output_file, agent_file: shared by all three agents;
agent_instructions_file: MCPAgent's own name and instructions, added to the shared ones.
--profile, --local or --openai picks a model profile, else models_file's "default".
tools_dir: the tools its MCP server serves (<tool>/tool.json; each tool is named after its
folder); tools_env: environment variables every tool gets, e.g. which agent runs it.
server_output: show the server's log lines (started, each tool it ran, errors) with the other
gray lines, with -d; off by default.
servers: the MCP servers the agent uses. A STDIO entry without "config" is its own server,
started as a child process when the agent starts and stopped when it exits; an entry with
"config" names another MCP server: a command (STDIO) or a URL (HTTP).

servers.description: The shared agents/tools folder, served by the agent's own MCP server.
